# Argon2 20190702

This directory contains the minimum portable reference implementation needed
for Argon2id key derivation. It is copied without source modifications from the
official Password Hashing Competition repository tag `20190702`, commit
`62358ba2123abd17fccf2a108a301d4b52c01a7c`.

- Official source: <https://github.com/P-H-C/phc-winner-argon2/tree/20190702>
- Source archive SHA-256: `DAF972A89577F8772602BF2EB38B6A3DD3D922BF5724D45E7F9589B5E830442C`
- License: Apache-2.0 or CC0-1.0; this product selects Apache-2.0
- Product build: reference implementation, `ARGON2_NO_THREADS`, parallelism 1

Command-line tools, benchmarks, tests, optimized architecture-specific source,
and the threaded backend are not built or distributed.
